en: Reduce the sidebar New button and project folder labels to 12px.
Replace the task Copy submenu with Copy working directory (Ctrl+Shift+C), Copy deep link (Alt+Ctrl+L), and Copy as Markdown.
On Windows, task links open an existing local task in Prism, including when Prism is closed. Links require the same local task data; archived or deleted tasks must be restored first.
zh: 侧栏“新建”按钮及项目文件夹名称统一缩小为 12px。
任务“复制”子菜单调整为“复制工作目录”（Ctrl+Shift+C）、“复制深度链接”（Alt+Ctrl+L）、“复制为 Markdown”。
Windows 下可用深度链接打开棱镜中的已有本地任务，也支持未启动时打开；链接依赖本机任务数据，已归档或删除的任务需先恢复。
